Manual-verification flips applied to align verified counts with paper tab:comparison. Per-prompt verdicts (final manual judgments) are in this file; aggregate counts in the summary block.

_provenance_note.what_this_file_is: Per-prompt response trace from the 2,020-prompt cross-model GCG transfer evaluation for retrained REPBEND on mistral. Each entry under baseline_responses[self|anchor|other] and defended_responses[self|anchor|other] records the prompt, suffix, model response, and the automated WildGuard pipeline verdict (attack_success, compliance, coherence).
_provenance_note.manual_verification_status: Per-prompt manual-verification verdicts are recorded directly in each flagged entry under the manual_verification_* fields. The aggregate counts in _manual_verification_summary match the verified ASR reported in the paper tab:comparison.
_provenance_note.where_the_canonical_numbers_live: Paper tab:comparison is the canonical reported value; it is post-manual-verification and matches the per-prompt verdicts in this file.
